name: @feldspar/imap
title: Mail (IMAP and SMTP)
description: Keep IMAP mailboxes in tables, with new mail arriving within seconds, and send mail through an account's own SMTP server.
supplies: Four tables: mail_accounts (IMAP and SMTP accounts, shared or personal), mail_folders, mail_messages (one row per mail, with its text and HTML) and mail_attachments (each stored as a file).
A background service that keeps each enabled account connected, and writes new mail and flag changes into the tables as they happen.
Actions to test an account, sync it now, set flags, move and delete mail, fetch an attachment, and send or reply from an account.
